results.name: Indoor Plants
results.description:
🌵 1. Plant: Aloe Vera
Description: A succulent plant with thick, pointed leaves. Commonly known for its medicinal properties.
Pot: White ceramic pot with a lightly textured surface, giving a natural and minimalist look.

🌿 2. Plant: Ficus Elastica ‘Tineke’ (Variegated Rubber Plant)
Description: A decorative indoor plant with large, firm leaves featuring white-cream edges.
Pot: Black ceramic pot with horizontal grooves, offering a modern aesthetic.

🌱 3. Plant: Monstera Deliciosa
Description: A tropical plant with large, deeply-split leaves. Known for its lush and dramatic appearance.
Pot: Plain beige cylindrical pot, designed to complement the bold foliage.

🌼 4. Plant: Spathiphyllum (Peace Lily)
Description: A popular air-purifying plant with wide glossy leaves and elegant white spathes.
Pot: White round pot placed on a thin wooden stand, blending classic and modern styles.
